conventions.sun: Direction from the Moon's centre to the Sun as its light arrives at the Moon at the sample time (light time and stellar aberration applied).
conventions.earth: Direction from the Moon's centre to the Earth's centre at the sample time, geometric.
conventions.between_samples: Interpolate the unit vectors spherically; do not interpolate longitude and latitude.
conventions.lit_fraction: (1 + cos i) / 2, i the angle between the two directions; a sphere and a point Sun.
